sv.title: Olle flyttar in på Hyllie Park-boende: ”Ljuset kommer alltid in om man öppnar dörren”
sv.summary: Nu kan Olle Ahlgren, 82, äntligen duscha regelbundet och slipper vänta på att få blöjorna bytta. Men flytten till Hyllie Parks äldreboende har lett till en ny insikt: han kommer aldrig att bo med sin fru igen. – Det får man leva med, man ska inte bara tänka på sig själv, säger han.

en.title: Olle moves into Hyllie Park care home: "The light always comes in if you open the door"
en.summary: Now Olle Ahlgren, 82, can finally shower regularly and no longer has to wait to have his diapers changed. But the move to Hyllie Park's care home has led to a new realisation: he will never live with his wife again. "You have to live with that, you shouldn't only think about yourself," he says.
